Items.Title: Tesla Account Email
Items.Description: Label only; not sent to Tesla. Identifies which account the cached credentials below belong to.

Items.Title: Tesla Refresh Token
Items.Description: OAuth refresh token for the Tesla account, obtained using an external setup tool. The library automatically obtains and renews the access token from this refresh token on every connection; the driver updates this value here if Tesla rotates it.

Items.Title: Tesla Energy Site ID
Items.Description: Optional. Enter the numeric Tesla energy site ID, or the site's name exactly as shown in the Tesla app/account (the driver looks up the matching ID automatically). Leave blank to use the account's first/default energy site.

Items.Title: Refresh Interval Seconds
Items.Description: How often the driver refreshes Powerwall status and power data from the Tesla cloud.
